headlines.title: Can’t Hit 10,000 Steps? This Small Change to Your Walking Routine Can Boost Heart Health
headlines.description: It’s not necessary to walk 10,000 steps a day to reduce heart disease risk, study finds. Add 1,000 steps to your existing routine to see heart health benefits.

headlines.title: MLB's CC Sabathia Shares Health Message, Talks Hall of Fame
headlines.description: MLB star CC Sabathia joins TODAY to share a message about the importance of understanding your cholesterol numbers and shares his own health scare. “I was pitching in the big leagues and had no idea I had this blockage and just got lucky enough to be able to catch it,” he says. He also opens up about being inducted into the Monument Park Hall of Fame at Yankee Stadium. “It means more than going into the Hall of Fame…To be able to come to the Bronx, put on the pinstripes and succeed here�

headlines.title: Tracking Macros for Beginners: A Step-by-Step Guide
headlines.description: Tracking your macros means going beyond calorie count and tracking your protein, carbohydrates, and fat. NBC News medical contributor Natalie Azar and TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer break down the process for tracking macros, discuss who should be doing it, list the recommended ratio for carbs, fat and protein, and the benefits of logging the information.

headlines.title: Why Women Are Struggling to Fill Estrogen Patch Prescriptions
headlines.description: Demand for hormone replacement therapy has soared after a study found the link between HRT and the risk of breast cancer to be much smaller than previously reported and after the FDA removed the black box warning in November 2025. That’s when women reported facing problems filling their prescriptions. NBC’s Yasmin Vossoughian, host of the "Here's the Scoop" podcast, reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Thousands removed from ACA coverage in effort to crack down on alleged fraud
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance announced a plan to remove about 750,000 people from Affordable Care Act plans in an effort to crack down on alleged healthcare fraud. NBC News’ Garrett Haake details why the administration is doing this now.

headlines.title: Walmart Deal Days sale is happening at the same time as fall Prime Day — here’s everything you should know
headlines.description: Walmart’s Deal Day sale event is returning from Oct. 5 to 11. The sale will happen at the same time as Prime Big Deal Days, also known as October Prime Day, and will include sales on beauty products, TVs, holiday gifts and more.

headlines.title: The best mouse traps we hope you never need
headlines.description: According to pest control experts, snap traps are best to help you solve a mouse problem in your home.

headlines.title: How to store your air conditioner for the winter
headlines.description: Removing your air conditioner from the window for winter can help prevent freezing temperatures and excess moisture from ruining it. HVAC experts share exactly how you should store it.

headlines.title: Every single benefit you get with an Amazon Prime membership
headlines.description: Benefits of a Prime membership extend beyond Prime Day. Sign up for a free trial to get perks like Grubhub+, fast shipping and Whole foods grocery delivery.

headlines.title: Trump’s FDA pick to face scrutiny over abortion pill access at confirmation hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Heidi Overton is also expected to address President Donald Trump’s claim labeling the measles vaccine “lethal.”

headlines.title: CDC reports first measles death amid confusion over Pennsylvania cases
headlines.description: The agency previously declined to recognize four measles-associated deaths the Pennsylvania Health Department reported over the last month.

headlines.title: Over 160,000 Pounds of Meat Recalled Due to Lack of Inspection, Receives Highest Risk Level From USDA
headlines.description: Approximately 167,639 pounds of raw pork, beef and goat products have been recalled for being produced without inspection. They were also falsely labeled.
